baseline_pool.identity_policy: frozen-protocol-and-replicate; execution date is metadata only

install.policy: Use the pinned Serena source snapshot from retrieval-serena-codex-mcp-v1 and install every product-authored Claude Code surface it documents (MCP, hooks, skills, plugins, rules, and guidance) into the lane-private CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR. Require provider-free artifact, configuration, and handshake proofs before any Anthropic request.

reset.policy: Delete the lane-private Claude config, tool state, indexes, generated guidance, hooks, plugins, and background processes after evidence capture; retain only immutable run artifacts and source hashes.

evaluation_protocol.instruction_policy: product-authored guidance only; no evaluator-authored invocation steering
evaluation_protocol.assignment_proof: provider-free pinned source, exact Claude configuration, native activation, and required MCP/hooks/skills/plugin smoke checks

registry_entry.notes: Claude Code preparation profile for Serena; source profile retrieval-serena-codex-mcp-v1. Provider-free native qualification passed for both active Lifecycle V1 sequences; provider execution is governed by the owner authorization and first-valid-sample policy.

network_isolation.model_shell_enforcement: seccomp denies AF_INET and AF_INET6 socket creation for the shell process and descendants

runtime.isolation_policy: fresh lane-specific agent home/XDG state; provider-only network with model shell and agent web tools disabled; sequential one-task prompt delivery; controller seed/verifier scripts excluded while controller-only affected-component compile commands retained; no acceptance-test assets injected; agent prompts carry normal software objectives

baseline_pool_reference.comparison_policy: paired baseline and treatment must share this baseline pool fingerprint and replicate

leakage_controls.model_writable_surface: target repository plus isolated model-output directory
remaining_limitations: Future semantic regression code is present from lane start. Agent prompts state normal software objectives and do not disclose controller scoring. Affected-component compile commands and controller verifier scripts remain controller-only; no acceptance-test assets are injected.
Task semantics and verifier names may still be searchable if the model intentionally uses external network access.

artifacts.final_diff_basis: ordered cumulative checkpoints plus final cumulative source diff from one composite root
